bc_time_horizon.definition: The stretch of future time a person is thinking about when they make a plan.
bc_time_horizon.example: Their time horizon was ten years ahead; mine was two.

lingua_franca.definition: A shared language used between people whose first languages differ. English is the most common one in international business.
lingua_franca.example: English works as the lingua franca, so nobody has to learn three languages for one meeting.

nomad_visa.definition: A residence permit for people who work remotely for foreign employers or clients without a local work permit.
nomad_visa.example: The nomad visa requires proof of income above a monthly threshold.

pd_influence.definition: Any effect one person has on another, from a request to advice, in either direction.
pd_influence.example: Influence is not a privilege: the newest member of the team influences the oldest one as well.
